title: Your Bug Log: The Mistakes You Actually Make
oneLiner: Every bug you noted after a failed run, grouped so the ones that keep coming back are on top.
keyTakeaway: After a couple of weeks the same few bugs repeat: off-by-one on a window shrink, forgetting to mark visited when you push. Knowing your own top five tells you exactly what to check before you press Run.
explanation:
When a run fails and a later run passes, the lesson asks what the bug was: one tap on a category, an optional note, or skip. That works on every graded exercise, and in Today's reps. You can add categories of your own, and add entries here by hand for bugs from a real interview or a whiteboard.

The top of this page counts the last two weeks by category, with the lessons each bug happened in. Click a category to list just those entries. Before you start a lesson where you logged a bug, it shows under "Your past bugs here", so the reminder turns up exactly when it is useful.

The log is kept in this browser and included in the progress export on the dashboard.
